title: Kissed Springy Vietnamese Linguine Pasta Ca Kho To
description: A plant-based Vietnamese dish featuring linguine pasta, bonito shave, and a jammy sauce, perfect for a midnight craving. This ca kho to dish is a unique fusion of Italian and Vietnamese flavors.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the linguine pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, maple syrup, and rice vinegar to make the sauce.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat and add the minced garlic, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the bonito flakes to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly, until lightly toasted.
Add the sauce to the skillet and bring to a simmer, cooking for 2 minutes until the sauce has thickened and turned jammy.
Stir in the chopped scallions, sesame seeds, salt, and black pepper.
Drain the cooked linguine pasta and add it to the skillet, tossing to combine with the sauce and bonito flakes.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the pasta is well coated with the sauce.
Serve the kissed springy Vietnamese linguine pasta ca kho to hot, garnished with additional scallions and sesame seeds if desired.
